name: Bing Wallpaper, Theme, Screensaver & Lock Screen
author: Chris Kitson
description: The Bing image of the day across your whole desktop, new every morning: your wallpaper, a matching theme built from its colors with Aether, your screensaver drawn as ASCII art, and your lock screen (with Lock Screen Explorer). Each part can be switched off.
